q.t: 1 + tan² θ equals…
q.e: Divide sin² θ + cos² θ = 1 by cos² θ.

q.t: 1 + cot² θ equals…
q.e: Divide sin² θ + cos² θ = 1 by sin² θ.

q.t: Find sec² θ − tan² θ.
q.e: Rearrange 1 + tan² θ = sec² θ.

q.t: Simplify (1 − sin² θ) sec² θ.
q.e: 1 − sin² θ = cos² θ, and cos² θ × sec² θ = 1.

q.t: cos θ × tan θ equals…
q.e: cos θ × sin θ/cos θ: the cos θ cancels.

q.t: Find 9 sec² A − 9 tan² A.
q.e: 9(sec² A − tan² A) = 9 × 1.

q.t: If sin θ = 3/5 (θ acute), use sin² θ + cos² θ = 1 to find cos θ.
If sec θ = 5/4 (θ acute), find tan θ.
q.e: tan² θ = sec² θ − 1 = 9/16.

q.t: (sec A + tan A)(1 − sin A) equals…
q.e: (1 + sin A)/cos A × (1 − sin A) = (1 − sin² A)/cos A = cos² A/cos A.

q.t: Find sin θ/cosec θ + cos θ/sec θ.
q.e: That is sin² θ + cos² θ.

q.t: If sec θ + tan θ = 4, find sec θ − tan θ.
q.e: (sec θ + tan θ)(sec θ − tan θ) = sec² θ − tan² θ = 1, so it is 1/4.

q.t: If sec θ + tan θ = 4, find sec θ.
q.e: sec θ − tan θ = 1/4. Add the two: 2 sec θ = 17/4.

q.t: If cosec θ − cot θ = 1/3, find cosec θ + cot θ.
q.e: Their product is cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1.

q.t: Simplify (1 + cot² A)(1 − cos A)(1 + cos A).
q.e: cosec² A × (1 − cos² A) = cosec² A × sin² A.

q.t: sin⁴ θ − cos⁴ θ equals…
q.e: Difference of squares: (sin² θ − cos² θ)(sin² θ + cos² θ), and the second bracket is 1.

q.t: If tan θ + cot θ = 2, find tan² θ + cot² θ.
q.e: Square: tan² θ + cot² θ + 2 tan θ cot θ = 4, and tan θ cot θ = 1.

q.t: If sin θ + cos θ = √2, find sin θ cos θ.
q.e: Square: 1 + 2 sin θ cos θ = 2.

q.t: Simplify (sec² θ − 1)(cosec² θ − 1).
q.e: That is tan² θ × cot² θ.

q.t: cos θ/(1 − sin θ) equals…
q.e: Multiply top and bottom by (1 + sin θ): cos θ(1 + sin θ)/cos² θ.

q.t: If x = a sec θ and y = b tan θ, find x²/a² − y²/b².
q.e: That is sec² θ − tan² θ.

q.t: If sin θ + cos θ = 7/5, find sin θ cos θ.
q.e: Square: 1 + 2 sin θ cos θ = 49/25, so 2 sin θ cos θ = 24/25.

q.t: If sin θ + cos θ = 7/5 and sin θ > cos θ, find sin θ − cos θ.
q.e: (sin θ − cos θ)² = 1 − 2 sin θ cos θ = 1 − 24/25 = 1/25.

q.t: Find sin⁶ θ + cos⁶ θ + 3 sin² θ cos² θ.
q.e: a³ + b³ = (a + b)³ − 3ab(a + b) with a + b = sin² θ + cos² θ = 1 gives 1 − 3 sin² θ cos² θ.

q.t: If cosec θ + cot θ = p, then cos θ equals…
q.e: cosec θ − cot θ = 1/p. Add and subtract to get cosec θ and cot θ; cos θ = cot θ ÷ cosec θ.

q.t: Find 2(sin⁶ θ + cos⁶ θ) − 3(sin⁴ θ + cos⁴ θ) + 1.
q.e: sin⁶ + cos⁶ = 1 − 3s²c² and sin⁴ + cos⁴ = 1 − 2s²c²: 2 − 6s²c² − 3 + 6s²c² + 1 = 0.

q.t: (tan θ + sec θ − 1)/(tan θ − sec θ + 1) equals…
q.e: Replace the 1 on top by sec² θ − tan² θ, factor out (sec θ + tan θ), and the rest cancels.

q.t: If x = r sin A cos C, y = r sin A sin C and z = r cos A, then x² + y² + z² equals…
q.e: x² + y² = r² sin² A (cos² C + sin² C) = r² sin² A. Add z² = r² cos² A.

q.t: If 1 + sin² θ = 3 sin θ cos θ, then tan θ equals…
q.e: Divide by cos² θ: sec² θ + tan² θ = 3 tan θ, so 2 tan² θ − 3 tan θ + 1 = 0.

q.t: (1 − cos θ)/(1 + cos θ) equals…
q.e: Multiply top and bottom by (1 − cos θ): (1 − cos θ)²/sin² θ = (1/sin θ − cos θ/sin θ)².

q.t: If cos θ + cos² θ = 1, find sin² θ + sin⁴ θ.
q.e: cos θ = 1 − cos² θ = sin² θ. So sin² θ + sin⁴ θ = cos θ + cos² θ = 1.

q.t: If sin θ + sin² θ = 1, find cos¹² θ + 3 cos¹⁰ θ + 3 cos⁸ θ + cos⁶ θ + 2 cos⁴ θ + 2 cos² θ − 2.
q.e: sin θ = cos² θ, so cos⁴ θ + cos² θ = 1. The expression is (cos⁴ θ + cos² θ)³ + 2(cos⁴ θ + cos² θ) − 2 = 1 + 2 − 2.

q.t: If tan θ + sin θ = m and tan θ − sin θ = n, then m² − n² equals…
q.e: m² − n² = 4 tan θ sin θ, and mn = tan² θ − sin² θ = tan² θ sin² θ.

q.t: If a cos θ + b sin θ = c, then a sin θ − b cos θ equals…
q.e: Square and add both expressions: the cross terms cancel and the sum is a² + b².

q.t: If cosec θ − sin θ = l and sec θ − cos θ = m, find l²m²(l² + m² + 3).
q.e: l = cos² θ/sin θ and m = sin² θ/cos θ, so lm = sin θ cos θ and l² + m² + 3 = 1/(sin² θ cos² θ).

q.t: If 4 sin θ + 3 cos θ = 3, find 3 sin θ − 4 cos θ.
If sec θ + tan θ = 3 (θ acute), find sin θ.
q.e: sec θ − tan θ = 1/3. So sec θ = 5/3, tan θ = 4/3, and sin θ = tan θ/sec θ.

q.t: (sin θ − 2 sin³ θ)/(2 cos³ θ − cos θ) equals…
q.e: Top: sin θ(1 − 2 sin² θ); bottom: cos θ(2 cos² θ − 1). Both brackets equal cos² θ − sin² θ.

q.t: If x = a cos³ θ and y = b sin³ θ, find (x/a)^(2/3) + (y/b)^(2/3).
q.e: (cos³ θ)^(2/3) + (sin³ θ)^(2/3) = cos² θ + sin² θ.

q.t: If cot θ + tan θ = x and sec θ − cos θ = y, find (x²y)^(2/3) − (xy²)^(2/3).
q.e: x = 1/(sin θ cos θ) and y = sin² θ/cos θ, so x²y = 1/cos³ θ and xy² = sin³ θ/cos³ θ. The result is sec² θ − tan² θ.

q.t: If sin θ + cos θ = p and sec θ + cosec θ = q, then q(p² − 1) equals…
q.e: q = p/(sin θ cos θ) and p² − 1 = 2 sin θ cos θ.
